en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall stone lookout tower with a balcony and upper structure, attached to a lower building, surrounded by trees and rocks. The front caption identifies the location as the Misina Riesz József lookout at 534 meters in the Mecsek hills near Pécs. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, an address, and a postmark from Pécs.
